## 2. Extraction and atomicity rule

This ledger uses stable, non-reusable IDs in the form `CSAA-000-REQ-nnn`.

- Each standalone `SHALL` or `SHALL NOT` occurrence receives its own row.
- When one deontic lead applies distributively to a following Markdown list, table, or code block, every immediate item receives its own row.
- Multiple deontic occurrences on one source line receive separate rows.
- A source list item remains one coupled clause at this charter level; its owning later document SHALL assign finer IDs where independently performable downstream obligations require separate implementation or verification.
- Definitions that merely name the keywords are excluded and recorded in the extraction exclusions.
- Non-keyword closure clauses expressed as “only when,” “cannot,” or an equivalent gate are included explicitly.
- Stage A W0-09 through W0-14 baselines are included even where the README carries them declaratively rather than repeating `SHALL`.
- Later-wave allocation means the current charter names an owner and boundary; it does not mean the future capability exists or passes.

## 5. Verification catalog

For Template §4 allocation completeness, each `ALLOCATED_TO_LATER_WAVE` row's own `CSAA-000-REQ-nnn` is the current source-owning requirement. No unauthored future member is assigned an invented descendant ID. Its later commission assigns any finer stable ID, and the future ledger/reference artifact must preserve a bidirectional `source requirement` / `derives from` binding to this row before claiming the obligation. The row's applicability cell names the exact future document or phase and activation condition; its oracle/evidence cells name one of these intended future verification methods:

| Future verification method | Intended future verification and evidence boundary |
| --- | --- |
| Controlled-document review | Independent review of the named future owner, its ledger, exact-source trace, and acceptance evidence |
| Executable-conformance review | Independently governed `JAN-CSAA-008` conformance, bound to exact subject/configuration/provider versions, coverage, expected result, and diagnostics |
| Register-package review | Exact-byte package, digest, response, register, and synchronized-carriage audit; the accountable sponsor alone disposes or confers |
| Owning-phase exit review | Exit/completion review proving the allocated companion exists and no later performance is claimed prematurely |
| Readiness and conformance review | Cross-prerequisite readiness review for `JAN-CSAA-006/007/008/011`, including independently governed oracle and red-first evidence |
| Implementation Definition-of-Done review | Independent implementation and executable-conformance review under a separate realization commission |
| Provider-qualification review | Exact-version, criterion-by-criterion provider qualification and decision-trail review under `JAN-CSAA-011` / Wave 4 |
| Authority-transfer review | Independent survivorship, enforced-artifact, residual-obligation, and authority-transfer review under a separate sponsor act |
| Scope-extension review | Independent six-part scope-extension, concern-ownership, conflict, and sponsor-decision review |
| Canon-successor governance review | Canon-controlled identity, relationship, non-rewrite, and exact-adoption review under the separately allocated successor commission |
| Oracle-conferral review | Independent review and authority/provenance trail proving affected oracle content remains Proposed until conferred |
| Oracle-divergence review | Divergence, preserved-prior-oracle, rationale, and no-inline-weakening review for a suspected-wrong oracle |
| Wave 1 boundary and non-performance audit | Independent pre/post repository/configuration/lockfile, execution-authorization, command/write/network/cleanup, topology/experiment-decision, and deliverable-trace review |
| Repository/configuration inventory inspection | Exact subject/worktree/content/configuration/lockfile, observation-time, workspace/project/source/tool/coverage, freshness/invalidation, raw-inspection, and downstream `JAN-CSAA-008` conformance review |
| Independent oracle-authoring review | Independently authored expected judgments, full source/rationale/subject/version provenance, analyzer-output comparison, and proof of no provider-output copying |
| Oracle non-conferral and no-false-green review | Visible Proposed/non-conferred oracle state and provenance plus negative `JAN-CSAA-008` evidence proving unreviewed expectations cannot make a gate green |
| Atomic realization-readiness review | Per-row prerequisite evidence for enforced contracts, obligation/artifact/verification bindings, independent fixtures, red-first and invariant/behavior/security conformance, provider qualification/removal, oracle non-conferral, non-circular construction, or exact prerequisite-commission scope |
| Atomic implementation Definition-of-Done review | Per-row implementation evidence for disposition closure, provenance/revision binding, full/incremental differential behavior, complete suites, false-green negatives, injected failures/disagreements, artifact consistency, agent trajectories/citations, finding/limitation disposition, operational security/recovery/resources, or the complete DoD matrix |
| Atomic authority-transfer review | Per-row survivorship, enforced-reference-artifact, non-erasure/removal, exact sponsor-act, synchronized register/manifest/traceability, residual-obligation, or no-act/no-transfer evidence |
| Atomic phase-exit/completion review | Per-row exact Wave 1–4 or whole-corpus exit/completion evidence for semantic subjects, assurance/oracle closure, red-first independence, work-package/test binding, authority/metadata/ownership/requirements/terms/catalog/capability/question/inventory/employment/provider/fork/review closure, or no-implied-artifact proof |
| Hybrid authority and executable-conformance review | Exact governing-source/concern-owner/authority/non-duplication comparison plus row-specific `JAN-CSAA-008` behavioral, trajectory, gate, or negative conformance; includes operational `JAN-CSAA-011` review where applicable |
| Independent fixture coverage review | Independent synthetic-fixture/scenario-to-obligation/declared-coverage trace, oracle conferral/provenance, exhaustiveness review within the boundary, and downstream conformance |
| Golden-fixture-backed conformance review | Exact independent JAN-CSAA-006 oracle provenance/conferral, JAN-CSAA-008 execution bound to that oracle, and JAN-CSAA-010 report citation to the same identity where applicable |
| Governed-input-loading trajectory review | Per-input execution trajectories for exact governed requirements, current inventory, contract/fixture identities, work-package ledger bindings, provider qualification/limitations, and the actual code/test/configuration/generated/user-change subject |
| Atomic V&V priority/report review | Per-priority executable and reporting evidence for invariants, conformance/mutation, provider differential, full/incremental equivalence, coding-agent employment/no-false-green behavior, and recovery/degraded operation |
| Semantic and verification precedence review | Contract, semantic-owner, oracle, and counterexample-trajectory evidence proving semantic meaning defeats implementation convenience, independently governed oracles defeat unsupported agent assertions, and suspected-wrong fixtures route divergence rather than override invariants |
